clue.text: Rapture when first of horses comes in, producing share of a large sum

indicators.note: the horse's initial letter enters the word for rapture, so it comes in

parts.note: rapture is a state of ecstatic trance

indicators.note: first of means only the opening letter of horses is used

explanation.surface: A racegoer is transported with joy as the first horses come in, landing a share of a big pot.
explanation.definitionFit: A tranche is a portion or slice, especially of a sum of money or an issue of shares.

clue.text: Difficulty getting clothes over belly

indicators.note: in a down clue, over means the clothes word sits above the belly word

parts.note: tights are a garment
a pot is a pot belly, a paunch

explanation.surface: Struggling to pull a garment over one's stomach.
explanation.definitionFit: Being in a tight spot means being in an awkward predicament.

clue.text: Article representing lunar type of eclipse

parts.note: an is the indefinite article

indicators.note: representing, read as presenting again in new form, rearranges the letters of lunar

explanation.surface: A newspaper piece about a kind of eclipse of the moon.
explanation.definitionFit: An annular eclipse leaves a ring of sunlight round the moon.

clue.text: Soldier captures enemy leader in the flesh

indicators.note: captures means the soldier word holds the letter inside it

parts.note: a corporal is a soldier, a non-commissioned officer

indicators.note: leader means the first letter of enemy

explanation.surface: A soldier takes the opposing general prisoner, in person.
explanation.definitionFit: Corporeal means bodily, having physical form.

clue.text: Side with slight advantage

explanation.surface: Taking a team's part gives it a small lead.
explanation.definitionFit: An edge is the side of something; having the edge means a small lead over rivals.

clue.text: Takes risks on business volumes

indicators.note: in an across clue, one piece on another means it follows that piece

parts.note: CO is the abbreviation for company, a business
to dice, as in dice with death, is to gamble or take risks

explanation.surface: A reckless entrepreneur gambles on a firm's sales figures.
explanation.definitionFit: Codices are old manuscript books, so they are bound volumes.

clue.text: Dismayed as man gets killed in action

parts.note: a chap is a man
the fallen are soldiers killed in battle

explanation.surface: Grief at the news that a man died fighting.
explanation.definitionFit: Chapfallen, with the jaw hanging, means downcast or disheartened.

clue.text: Made to capture rook, but one can mate with the queen

definitions.text: one can mate with the queen

indicators.note: to capture means the word for made holds the rook's letter inside

parts.note: made, as in done or finished, gives done
R is the chess abbreviation for rook

explanation.surface: A chess game where a rook is taken, yet the queen can still be mated.
explanation.walkthrough: The chess picture misleads: the queen is a queen bee, and the male bee's role is to mate with her.
explanation.definitionFit: A drone is a male honeybee whose purpose is to mate with the queen.

clue.text: Taken to task about secret

parts.note: C, circa, is the abbreviation for about
something secret is hidden

explanation.surface: Someone is told off over a matter kept quiet.
explanation.definitionFit: Chidden is an old past participle of chide, to scold or rebuke.

clue.text: Absolute monarch succeeding female

indicators.note: succeeding means the monarch's letters come after the female word

parts.note: she is the female pronoun
ER, Elizabeth Regina, is the Queen

explanation.surface: An absolute ruler takes the throne after a woman.
explanation.definitionFit: Sheer means utter or complete, as in sheer nonsense.

clue.text: King I held to be a hopeless case

indicators.note: the word for one is held between the king's two letters

parts.note: GR, Georgius Rex, is King George's royal cipher
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A monarch, once taken captive, admits he is beyond saving.
explanation.definitionFit: A goner is someone doomed or past saving, a lost cause.

clue.text: To give allure to a girl, some make-up is needed

indicators.note: make-up, read as the letters being made up afresh, tells us to rearrange the words a girl some

explanation.surface: Advice that a young woman needs cosmetics to look attractive.
explanation.definitionFit: To glamorise something is to make it seem more attractive or alluring.

clue.text: Fat cat finally gets permit

indicators.note: finally points to the closing letter of the word cat

parts.note: to permit is to allow

explanation.surface: An overweight cat is at last given the run of the house.
explanation.definitionFit: Tallow is rendered animal fat used for candles and soap.

clue.text: Criminal proposal to secure objective

indicators.note: to secure means to hold fast, so the proposal word wraps round the objective

parts.note: a proposal is an offer
an objective is an end, as in ends and means

explanation.surface: A lawbreaker puts forward a plan to achieve a goal.
explanation.definitionFit: An offender is a person who has broken the law, a criminal.

clue.text: Hear wild animal's go free from circus

indicators.note: hear says the phrase about the animal is spoken, not spelt

parts.note: the hippo would roam, shortened to hippo'd roam

explanation.surface: A large beast escapes from the big top.
explanation.definitionFit: A hippodrome is an arena for horse and chariot shows, and also a name for a circus or music hall.

clue.text: Contract's in the bag

explanation.surface: A signed deal is settled, or as they say, in the bag.
explanation.definitionFit: To purse the lips is to contract them; a purse is also a small bag for money.

clue.text: Damned bad dictionary gone into by people

parts.note: bad means ill, as in ill will

indicators.note: the dictionary's letters are entered by the people word, which sits inside them

parts.note: OED is the Oxford English Dictionary
men means people, as in men and women of the town

explanation.surface: A scathing review condemns a poor dictionary that many people have consulted.
explanation.definitionFit: Something ill-omened is doomed or fated to fail, as if cursed.

clue.text: Wrongdoer's crimes disturbed social worker

indicators.note: disturbed means the letters of crimes are thrown into disorder

parts.note: an ant is a social insect, a worker in its colony

explanation.surface: A criminal's offences shocked a social worker.
explanation.walkthrough: The 's after the definition stands for is, linking it to the wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: A miscreant is a villain or lawbreaker.

clue.text: Am created free, but have to set limits

indicators.note: free, as in set loose, means the letters of am created are rearranged

explanation.surface: Born free, yet obliged to accept boundaries.
explanation.definitionFit: To demarcate is to mark out the boundaries of something.

clue.text: Such a picture framed only occasionally?

definitions.text: Such a picture framed only occasionally?

parts.words: Such a picture framed only occasionally?
parts.note: read framed as camera frames taken: a film made by shooting a frame only now and then, which speeds events up on playback

explanation.surface: A painting that seldom gets hung in a frame.
explanation.definitionFit: Time-lapse photography captures frames at long intervals so slow processes appear fast.

clue.text: Prophet from a church in African country

indicators.note: in means the article and church go inside the country's name

parts.note: Mali is a country in West Africa

explanation.surface: A preacher comes from a congregation in West Africa.
explanation.definitionFit: Malachi is the Old Testament prophet with the last book of the Old Testament.

clue.text: Deal with mass hysteria caused by witches here

parts.note: a deal is a sale
M is the abbreviation for mass in physics

explanation.surface: A trader copes with a crowd gone mad over witchcraft.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is a place: the Massachusetts town where witch trials were held in 1692.
explanation.definitionFit: The 1692 witch trials in the Massachusetts town were driven by mass panic over witchcraft.

clue.text: Mean to get the information

explanation.surface: A spiteful informer passes on the facts.
explanation.definitionFit: Low-down as an adjective means base or despicable; the lowdown is the inside facts.

clue.text: Royal servant speaking for the defence

indicators.note: speaking says the phrase for a royal servant is heard rather than spelt

parts.note: a royal servant is a palace aide

explanation.surface: A courtier testifies on behalf of the accused in court.
explanation.definitionFit: A palisade is a fence of stakes built as a defensive barrier.

clue.text: Falstaff's crony, with hollow legs?

indicators.note: with, read as carrying within, puts the empty letter inside the legs word

parts.note: pins is slang for legs
a hollow is an empty space, shaped like an O

explanation.surface: Shakespeare's fat knight's companion is mocked for spindly legs.
explanation.walkthrough: POINS is Falstaff's drinking companion in Shakespeare's Henry IV plays.
explanation.definitionFit: Ned Poins is the friend of Falstaff and Prince Hal in Henry IV.

clue.text: Name many held in Jerusalem?

indicators.note: held in means the many letter sits inside the city's name

parts.note: Sion, or Zion, is a poetic name for Jerusalem
M is the Roman numeral for a thousand, so many

explanation.surface: Asking about a person's name, with crowds gathered in the holy city.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark flags that the definition is a name given as an example.
explanation.definitionFit: Simon is a man's name, an example of a forename.

clue.text: Daughter less polished as artist

parts.note: D is the abbreviation for daughter in family trees
rawer means more crude, less refined

explanation.surface: A girl with rough manners is said to be an artist.
explanation.definitionFit: A drawer is one who draws, a sketcher or illustrator.

clue.text: A lot of cows belonging lo another dairy

indicators.note: belonging to means the letters are part of the words that follow

explanation.surface: Some cattle belonging to a neighbouring dairy farm.
explanation.definitionFit: A herd is a group of cattle kept together.

clue.text: One new item of furniture appears to get in the way

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one
a commode is a chest of drawers or a chair concealing a chamber pot

explanation.surface: A newly bought chest of drawers turns out to block the hallway.
explanation.definitionFit: To incommode is to inconvenience or hinder someone, to be an obstruction.

clue.text: Concealing origin of odour, part of body given a nice smell

indicators.note: concealing means the limb word hides a letter within it

parts.note: an arm is a part of the body

indicators.note: origin of means the first letter of odour

explanation.surface: A limb hiding a whiff of body odour is given a pleasant perfume.
explanation.definitionFit: An aroma is a pleasant, distinctive scent.

clue.text: Technique for one type of fiction

explanation.surface: A writer's method for a certain genre of novel.
explanation.definitionFit: Science can mean a skill or technique, as in the science of boxing; science fiction is a literary genre.

clue.text: Action to recover point by football team in return

indicators.note: in return says the team name is read backwards

parts.note: United is a common football club name, such as Manchester United
E, east, is a point of the compass

explanation.surface: A football club goes back to the courts to win a point.
explanation.definitionFit: Detinue is the legal action for recovering goods wrongfully detained.
